info.title: Neural4D API
info.description: API v1 provides model discovery, managed input files, asynchronous generation and 3D processing tasks, task progress, credit usage, and credit balance.

tags.name: Models
tags.description: Discover the models and capabilities available to the current API key.

tags.name: Files
tags.description: Create and inspect managed input files.

bearerAuth.description: Neural4D API key using the Bearer scheme.

type.description: High-level error category for programmatic handling.

message.example: prompt is required and must be a non-empty string

param.description: Request field associated with the error, or null when the error is not field-specific.

request_id.description: Request ID used to trace this error.

doc_url.description: Optional documentation URL with more information about the error.

credits.description: Credits charged for the task or submission.

url.description: Temporary signed URL for downloading the generated image.

format.description: Image file format when known, such as png.

url.description: Temporary signed URL for downloading the generated video.

format.description: Video file format when known, such as mp4.

duration_seconds.description: Generated video duration in seconds when available.

resolution.description: Generated video resolution when available, such as 720p.

url.description: Temporary signed URL for downloading the generated 3D model.

format.description: 3D model file format when known, such as glb.

thumbnail_urls.description: Temporary signed URLs for model preview images.

polycount.description: Number of polygon faces in the model when available.

has_texture.description: Whether the model includes texture data when known.

has_pbr.description: Whether the model includes PBR material data when known.

url.description: Temporary signed URL for downloading the file.

format.description: File format represented by this URL.

images.description: Generated image files returned after the task succeeds.

videos.description: Generated video files returned after the task succeeds.

models.description: Generated 3D model files returned after the task succeeds.

files.description: Converted files returned after the task succeeds.

type.description: Operation type performed by the task.

model.description: Public provider/model alias returned by GET /openapi/v1/models.

usage.description: Credits charged for this task when available.

error.description: Error details when the task fails.

result.description: Task result returned after asynchronous processing completes.

usage.description: Total credits charged for the submitted tasks when available.

id.description: Public model identifier used in generation requests.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the model entry was created.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the model entry was updated.

owned_by.description: Provider or organization that owns the model.

description.description: Model description maintained by the model registry.

architecture.description: Input and output modalities maintained by the runtime model registry.

supported_parameters.description: Request parameter names maintained by the runtime model registry.

default_parameters.description: Default request parameter values maintained by the runtime model registry.

data.description: Models available to the authenticated account.

prompt.description: Text instruction describing the image to generate or edit.

images.description: Reference images supplied by URL or managed file key.

n.description: Number of image generation tasks to create.

resolution.description: Named resolution published for the selected image model, currently 1K or 2K. Use this or size.

size.description: Pixel size in WIDTHxHEIGHT form. Use this or resolution.

extra_body.description: Provider parameters forwarded after key, size, depth, and payload validation.

prompt.description: Text instruction describing the video to generate.

images.description: Reference images supplied by URL or managed file key.

n.description: Number of video generation tasks to create.

resolution.description: Named resolution published for the selected video model, currently 480p, 720p, 1080p, 1K, or 2K. Use this or size.

size.description: Pixel size in WIDTHxHEIGHT form. Use this or resolution.

extra_body.description: Provider parameters forwarded after key, size, depth, and payload validation.

quality.description: Target mesh quality for the refine task.

prompt.description: Text instruction describing the texture to generate.

image.description: One reference image supplied by URL or managed file key.

urls.description: Temporary signed download URLs for available result files.

thumbnail_urls.description: Temporary signed URLs for available preview images.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the signed URLs expire.

id.description: Task or model ID associated with these files.

model.description: Public model identifier when it can be resolved from the usage record.

credits.description: Credits charged by this usage record.

data.description: Usage records on the current page.

total_credits.description: Total credits represented by the filtered result set.

has_more.description: Whether another page of usage records is available.

TaskType.description: Stable operation type assigned to an asynchronous task.

TaskStatus.description: Normalized lifecycle status of an asynchronous task.

TaskError.description: Failure details recorded by asynchronous processing.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the task failure.

failed_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the task failed.

retryable.description: Whether retrying the same operation may succeed.

target_polycount.description: Target face count passed to the remesh pipeline.

url.description: HTTPS source URL. Every DNS result and redirect is checked for a public network address, then media type, size, and fetch time limits are applied.

fileKey.description: Managed file key returned by the file management endpoint.

FileReference.description: A file reference containing one HTTPS URL or one managed file key.

ExtraBody.description: Provider parameters are validated against the selected model policy. Keys, nesting depth, property count, and serialized payload size are bounded before forwarding.

prompt.description: Text instruction describing the 3D model to generate.

images.description: One reference image supplied by URL or managed file key.

with_texture.description: Whether to generate texture data for the model.

with_pbr.description: Whether to generate PBR material data for the model.

target_polycount.description: Target face count. standard supports 100000 to 500000; high and extra_high support 500000 to 1000000.

art_style.description: Style instruction for the 3D output, including chibi-style generation.

n.description: Number of 3D generation tasks to create.

fileKey.description: Internal managed file key used by generation tasks.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the file was created.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the file was updated.

data.description: Managed files visible to the authenticated account.

first_id.description: ID of the first file in this page, or null when the page is empty.

last_id.description: ID of the last file in this page, or null when the page is empty.

has_more.description: Whether another page of managed files is available.

file.description: Local file content uploaded to managed storage.

input_modalities.description: Input modalities published for this model.

output_modalities.description: Output modalities published for this model.

total_credits.description: Total credits currently available to the account.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp for the nearest expiring credit balance, or null when no balance expires.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the credit balance was updated.

type.description: Operation type performed by the task.

model.description: Public provider/model alias returned by GET /openapi/v1/models.

usage.description: Credits charged for this task when available.

error.description: Error details when the task fails.

RateLimitLimitRequests.description: Request limit for the current window.

RateLimitRemainingRequests.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

RateLimitResetRequests.description: Time until the request window resets, such as 1s.
